evidence: Our company is increasingly integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies into our operations to enhance efficiency, decision-making, and customer experience.
We are committed to mitigating these risks through rigorous testing, continuous monitoring, and adherence to ethical guidelines.
To the extent we use PHI to train AI, we are required to follow laws, regulations, and contractual requirements on uses and disclosures of PHI.
We may also be dependent on third-party AI models and vendors, whose availability, reliability, performance, or terms of use may change.
ai_positioning.summary: BTSG intègre progressivement l'IA dans ses opérations pour améliorer l'efficacité et la prise de décision, mais adopte une approche prudente en mettant l'accent sur la gestion des risques (biais, confidentialité, cybersécurité) et la conformité réglementaire.
